builtins.name: print
builtins.doc: Writes the values to the log (and the editor's console and status bar), separated by spaces.

builtins.name: str
builtins.doc: The value as text.

builtins.name: num
builtins.doc: The number in a string, or nil if it isn't one.

builtins.name: floor
builtins.doc: Rounds down.

builtins.name: ceil
builtins.doc: Rounds up.

builtins.name: round
builtins.doc: Rounds to the nearest whole number.

builtins.name: abs
builtins.doc: The value without its sign.

builtins.name: sqrt
builtins.doc: Square root (x must not be negative).

builtins.name: sin
builtins.doc: Sine of an angle in degrees.

builtins.name: cos
builtins.doc: Cosine of an angle in degrees.

builtins.name: atan2
builtins.doc: The angle of (x, y), in degrees.

builtins.name: pow
builtins.doc: x to the power y.

builtins.name: min
builtins.doc: The smallest of the numbers.

builtins.name: max
builtins.doc: The largest of the numbers.

builtins.name: clamp
builtins.doc: v kept between lo and hi.

builtins.name: lerp
builtins.doc: From a (t = 0) to b (t = 1). Numbers or vec2s.

builtins.name: random
builtins.doc: A random number: 0..1, 0..n or a..b. Deterministic per world.

builtins.name: vec2
builtins.doc: A 2D vector. Has .x, .y and .length; + - with vec2s, * / by numbers.

builtins.name: length
builtins.doc: How long a vec2 is.

builtins.name: normalize
builtins.doc: v scaled to length 1 (or (0, 0)).

builtins.name: dot
builtins.doc: The dot product of two vec2s.

builtins.name: distance
builtins.doc: The distance between two points.

builtins.name: angle
builtins.doc: The direction of a vec2, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = down).

builtins.name: from_angle
builtins.doc: A vec2 pointing that way.

builtins.name: rgb
builtins.doc: A colour ("#rrggbbaa") for colour fields, e.g. self.Shape.color = rgb(255, 0, 0).

builtins.name: len
builtins.doc: How many items (or characters).

builtins.name: push
builtins.doc: Adds value at the end; returns the list.

builtins.name: pop
builtins.doc: Removes and returns the last item.

builtins.name: remove
builtins.doc: Removes and returns the item at index (-1 = the last).

builtins.name: contains
builtins.doc: Whether the list holds the value.

builtins.name: range
builtins.doc: A list of numbers: 0..n-1, or a up to (not including) b.

builtins.name: key_down
builtins.doc: Whether a key is held: "left", "a", "space", "shift", "F1"...

builtins.name: key_pressed
builtins.doc: Whether a key went down this frame.

builtins.name: key_released
builtins.doc: Whether a key came up this frame.

builtins.name: mouse_down
builtins.doc: Whether a mouse button is held (0 left, 1 right, 2 middle).

builtins.name: mouse_pressed
builtins.doc: Whether a mouse button went down this frame.

builtins.name: mouse_position
builtins.doc: Where the mouse is, in game pixels.

builtins.name: button_down
builtins.doc: Whether a gamepad button is held, on that pad (0 to 3) or any: a b x y, lb rb, lt rt (the triggers), back start guide, ls rs (the sticks pressed in), up down left right (the d-pad); PlayStation names ("cross", "circle"...) and "l1", "r2", "select", "menu" work too. Every pad has the same Xbox-style layout.

builtins.name: button_pressed
builtins.doc: Whether a gamepad button went down this step, on that pad or any (names as button_down()).

builtins.name: button_released
builtins.doc: Whether a gamepad button came up this step, on that pad or any (names as button_down()).

builtins.name: axis
builtins.doc: A stick's "left_x", "left_y", "right_x", "right_y" (-1 to 1; +y is down) or a trigger's "lt", "rt" (0 to 1), with the dead zone taken off. Without a pad, the one pushed furthest.

builtins.name: stick
builtins.doc: The "left" or "right" stick as a vec2, each part -1 to 1 (+y is down), with the dead zone taken off.

builtins.name: gamepad_connected
builtins.doc: Whether that gamepad (0 to 3) is plugged in, or (without one) any.

builtins.name: gamepad_count
builtins.doc: How many gamepads are plugged in.

builtins.name: gamepad_name
builtins.doc: What a gamepad calls itself ("" if there is none); without a pad, the first one plugged in.

builtins.name: last_button
builtins.doc: The name of a gamepad button pressed this step on any pad ("" if none), as button_down() takes it: for letting players choose their buttons.

builtins.name: last_input
builtins.doc: What the player touched last: "keyboard", "mouse" or "gamepad" ("" before anything), kept from scene to scene: for showing a key's name or a button's in prompts.

builtins.name: rumble
builtins.doc: Shakes a gamepad (or every one): strength 0 to 1, for that long; 0 stops it. True if a pad could.

builtins.name: time
builtins.doc: Seconds since the game started.

builtins.name: find
builtins.doc: The first entity with this name, or nil.

builtins.name: find_all
builtins.doc: A list of every entity with this name.

builtins.name: find_tagged
builtins.doc: Every entity with the tag (or with all of the tags given: `find_tagged("enemy", "flying")`), as a list. Tags are set in the inspector (the Tags component) or with add_tag().

builtins.name: first_tagged
builtins.doc: The first entity with the tag (or with all of the tags given), or nil.

builtins.name: has_tag
builtins.doc: Whether the entity has the tag (exactly: case counts).

builtins.name: add_tag
builtins.doc: Gives the entity a tag (it gets a Tags component if it has none). A tag is up to 31 letters, digits and _-.:/ characters.

builtins.name: remove_tag
builtins.doc: Takes a tag off the entity; true if it had it.

builtins.name: tags
builtins.doc: The entity's tags, as a list of strings.

builtins.name: destroy
builtins.doc: Removes the entity (and its children) at the end of the step.

builtins.name: spawn
builtins.doc: Adds a copy of a scene file's entities and returns the first. With a parent, position is in its space.

builtins.name: children
builtins.doc: The entity's direct children, as a list.

builtins.name: child
builtins.doc: The direct child with that name, or nil.

builtins.name: has
builtins.doc: Whether the entity has the component, e.g. has(other, "RigidBody").

builtins.name: add
builtins.doc: Adds a component (with its defaults) and returns it.

builtins.name: remove_component
builtins.doc: Removes a component.

builtins.name: apply_force
builtins.doc: Pushes a RigidBody over the next step. With a world point, also spins it.

builtins.name: apply_impulse
builtins.doc: Changes a RigidBody's velocity at once.

builtins.name: raycast
builtins.doc: The first solid collider on the line: [entity, point, normal], or nil.

builtins.name: entity_at
builtins.doc: The collider under a point, or nil.

builtins.name: play_sound
builtins.doc: Plays a WAV file from the project.

builtins.name: send
builtins.doc: Calls a function in another entity's script if it has one; nil otherwise.

builtins.name: load_scene
builtins.doc: Ends this scene and starts the scene file at `path` (after this step). In the editor's Play, the scene is swapped in until Stop.

builtins.name: quit
builtins.doc: Ends the game. In the editor, it stops playing.

builtins.name: tile_at
builtins.doc: The character in the Tilemap cell under a world point ("" outside the map).

builtins.name: set_tile
builtins.doc: Changes the Tilemap cell under a world point; false outside the map.

builtins.name: tile_solid
builtins.doc: Is the Tilemap cell under a world point one of the map's solid characters? (false outside the map)

builtins.name: tile_center
builtins.doc: The world position of the centre of the Tilemap cell under a point.

builtins.name: substr
builtins.doc: Part of a string: count characters from start (a negative start counts from the end).

builtins.name: save_data
builtins.doc: Keeps a value (a number, string, true/false, nil, vec2, or a list of those) for the next time the game runs, as name.txt in the game's folder for saved data. Returns false if it couldn't be written.

builtins.name: load_data
builtins.doc: The value save_data() kept under this name, or the default if there is none (or the file is damaged).

builtins.name: has_data
builtins.doc: Is there saved data by this name?

builtins.name: delete_data
builtins.doc: Forgets the saved data by this name. True if it's gone (or never was).

builtins.name: data_names
builtins.doc: The names of all the game's saved data, in order.

builtins.name: last_key
builtins.doc: The name of a key pressed this step ("" if none), as key_down() takes it: for letting players choose their keys.

builtins.name: set_volume
builtins.doc: Sets a mix bus's volume: "master", "sfx", "music", "ui" or "ambient"; 0 is silent, 1 full (up to 2). A Sound component's bus field says which it plays on; play_sound() plays on sfx.

builtins.name: volume
builtins.doc: A mix bus's volume ("master", "sfx", "music", "ui" or "ambient").

properties.name: rotation
properties.doc: Transform.rotation (degrees, clockwise), relative to the parent

properties.name: scale
properties.doc: Transform.scale (set a number or a vec2)

properties.name: global_position
properties.doc: Where it is in the world, after its parents

properties.name: global_rotation
properties.doc: Rotation in the world, after its parents

properties.name: parent
properties.doc: The parent entity, or nil. Set it to reparent (it stays where it is on screen)

properties.name: id
properties.doc: A number unique to the entity

callbacks.name: start
callbacks.doc: Runs once, before the entity's first update.

callbacks.name: update
callbacks.doc: Runs every fixed step; dt is the step in seconds.

callbacks.name: on_collision
callbacks.signature: on_collision(other: entity, normal: vec2, speed: number) -> void

callbacks.name: on_trigger
callbacks.doc: other entered a trigger (this entity's or its own).

keywords.var: Declares a variable. At the top of a file: one per entity, kept between calls.
keywords.for: for item in list { ... }  /  for i in 10 { ... }
keywords.return: Returns from the function (with a value).
keywords.continue: Skips to the next turn of the loop.
keywords.nil: Nothing. nil, false and 0 count as false.
keywords.@strict: At the top of a file: every var, parameter and function result must have a type (`var hp: int = 3`, `var hp := 3`, `func f(a: vec2) -> bool`).

types.name: number
types.doc: Any number (all numbers are floating point). `float` means the same.

types.name: int
types.doc: A whole number. Literals like `3` are ints; `/` gives a number, and `floor()` / `round()` make one whole again.

types.name: list
types.doc: A list. `list[number]` says what its items are.

types.name: any
types.doc: Anything: checked only when it runs.
